description: Comprehensive deployment readiness validation with test failure tracking, deployment history analysis, and hard blocking for unsafe deployments. Integrates with smart_git_push for deployment gating.

allowMockCode.description: Allow mock code in deployment (NOT RECOMMENDED)

blockOnFailingTests.description: Block deployment if tests are failing

businessJustification.description: Business justification for overrides (required for emergency_override)

enableMemoryIntegration.description: Enable memory entity storage for deployment assessment tracking and historical analysis

maxTestFailures.description: Maximum test failures allowed (0 = zero tolerance)

migrateExistingHistory.description: Migrate existing JSON-based deployment history to memory entities

operation.description: Type of deployment readiness check to perform

projectPath.description: Path to project directory (defaults to current working directory)

testSuiteRequired.description: Required test suites that must pass

name: deployment_readiness
